We will take the ferry to Cacilhas and ascend to Almada Velha. Our first main stop is the tranquil botanical gardens of **Casa da Cerca - Centro de Arte Contemporânea**, where we’ll take a meditative, reflective time while enjoying expansive views across the river and city. From the clifftop, we’ll descend to **Jardim do Rio** to watch the sun set directly behind the 25 de Abril Bridge. To close the evening, we will stroll along the waterfront path to the **Cacilhas Lighthouse** just in time to watch the quasi-full moon rise over the broad waters of the Tagus bay. We expect to walk only a few hours return, but **we will stay out all day**. The rest of the time will be about the enjoyment of nature and each other's company. Please don't forget your **PACK DINNER, your WATER,** and a little **mat to sit on the floor** if you need it. Even in Summer, it can be cool on exposed sites over the water. title: Meet Local & International Friends - Casual Socialising Evening- Music & DJ
description: Looking for a fun and friendly way to spend your Friday evening in Lisbon? Whether you live here, recently moved to the city, or you're simply passing through while travelling, you're very welcome to join us! International Friends Lisbon is a growing community of local Portuguese and international people who come together regularly. Some people are joining for the first time, while others return week after week to catch up with familiar faces. Come alone or bring your friends — either way, you'll be welcome! ❤️ 🃏 LET'S MAKE SOCIALISING EASIER! Walking into a busy social event can sometimes feel a little awkward - so we make it easier! We run fun matching and connection activities to get people moving around, talking and mixing with different people. Nothing complicated - just a bit of fun to get conversations started! 😄 🎁 FUN COMMUNITY RAFFLE We also have a fun raffle draw during the evening, adding a little extra excitement to the night! 🕖 COME EARLY & ENJOY THE WHOLE EVENING Doors open at 7:00 PM, and we strongly recommend arriving early. The first part of the evening is all about socialising, conversations, activities and enjoying the community atmosphere. 🎧 From around 11:00 PM, we have a DJ playing in one side of the venue giving you the choice between ending your night with a fun dance or continue socialising in other rooms of the venue.
